item.title: Brim 1.4
item.description:
• Fixed a crash when Claude Code asked a second question in the same session.
  • Requests from subagents running in parallel now wait in the notch one after another instead of going back to the terminal.
  • Claude Code and Codex alerts keep working if Brim's socket file is deleted, and opening Brim twice no longer starts a second copy.
  • Stopping the music no longer closes an open permission request.
  • After pausing, the artwork leaves after 30 seconds even if the player keeps sending updates.
  • Songs and podcasts of an hour or more show the time as 1:02:05.
  • Large album covers use much less memory.
  • If the Now Playing helper crashes, Brim keeps restarting it instead of giving up.
  • Connecting the agents keeps your own hooks, and the backup keeps your settings from before Brim.

item.title: Brim 1.3
item.description:
• Brim updates itself: it checks for new versions once a day, and you can right-click the notch and choose Check for Updates. Turn on Install Updates Automatically in Settings to skip the prompt.
  • The welcome screen now sets up how the notch opens, which alerts you see, and the Claude Code and Codex connection, and shows that right-clicking the notch opens Settings.
